machine.name: asobou
machine.description: Go! Go! Connie-chan! Asobou Mouse (1997) (alias for um6578)

description.description: A point and click game made by Bandai in 1997, based on a Japanese children's series known as Ponkickies. The game uses a PS/2 mouse which makes it quite unique among plug and plays. It uses the UM6578, which is a Famiclone that can display more colors at once and produce superior audio playback over the Famicom and NES. Minigames can be played by clicking one of the characters.
